resources.string: Reads the current URL from Chrome, Samsung Internet, YouTube, X, and Instagram so the side-key shortcut can capture it without a screenshot.

No captured links yet.\nDouble-press the side key or share a link to iofast.
iofast hit a problem. Open iofast to see the problem log.

Side key: Settings → Advanced features → Side key → Double press → Open app → iofast capture. Then open a page in Chrome or Samsung Internet, or a post in YouTube, X or Instagram, and double-press the side key.
If capture fails or turns itself off, tap Copy or Share and send this to whoever is helping you set up iofast.
